$comment: OPTIONAL Playwright-attach fallback for Claude Code (NOT for Cowork, which uses the Claude in Chrome tools). OFF by default: this file is inert until you wire it into your Claude Code MCP config, and it only ATTACHES to a Chrome you started yourself with remote debugging on your NORMAL profile — so you stay logged in. It never launches a fresh/headless browser. Setup: start Chrome with:  '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome"  then enable this server. No credentials or cookies are handled by basivo-operator.
